## Reinsurance Group of America Executives to Participate in the 2026 Barclays Annual Global Financial Services Conference


September 8, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investor.rgare.com/node/23071/pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 8, 2026--[Reinsurance Group of America, Incorporated](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rgare.com%2F&esheet=54599185&newsitemid=20260908214774&lan=en-US&anchor=Reinsurance+Group+of+America%2C+Incorporated&index=1&md5=dc81b869634257af7c0358a7b1c7280f) (NYSE: RGA), a leading global life and health reinsurer, announced today that Laura Cockrill, Chief Financial Officer, and Ron Herrmann, Chief Commercial Officer and Executive Vice President of Americas and EMEA, will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 Barclays Annual Global Financial Services Conference on Tuesday, Sept. 15, 2026, from 8:15 a.m. to 8:55 a.m. Eastern Time.


A live webcast of this event will be accessible through the RGA Investor Relations website at[https://investor.rgare.com/news-events/events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.rgare.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents&esheet=54599185&newsitemid=20260908214774&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.rgare.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents&index=2&md5=b20164a366ed377098d303dc12a09f2a) . Please visit the link in advance to allow time to register. A replay also will be available.


**ABOUT RGA**


[Reinsurance Group of America, Incorporated](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rgare.com%2F&esheet=54599185&newsitemid=20260908214774&lan=en-US&anchor=Reinsurance+Group+of+America%2C+Incorporated&index=3&md5=67b776369adbeff06fcaa42c7b53b966) is a global industry leader specializing in life and health reinsurance and financial solutions that help clients effectively manage risk and optimize capital. Founded in 1973, RGA is one of the world’s largest and most respected reinsurers and remains guided by a powerful purpose: to make financial protection accessible to all. As a global capabilities and solutions leader, RGA empowers partners through bold innovation, relentless execution, and dedicated client focus – all directed toward creating sustainable long-term value. RGA has approximately $4.3 trillion of life reinsurance in force and total assets of $167.1 billion as of June 30, 2026. To learn more about RGA and its businesses, please visit[www.rgare.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rgare.com%2F&esheet=54599185&newsitemid=20260908214774&lan=en-US&anchor=www.rgare.com&index=4&md5=5283aeb9e40877946f6b86c05bd4f3bb) or follow RGA on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Frga-reinsurance-group-of-america-incorporated%2F&esheet=54599185&newsitemid=20260908214774&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=5&md5=bb01db0131f804fdb2ec51b142458766) and[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2FRGAGlobal%2F&esheet=54599185&newsitemid=20260908214774&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=6&md5=aea690e0ea61ecfb1f9ef3240253f88d) .
